deny_patterns.reason: is a distance to a specific nucleon number
is a distance to a closure

firewall.normalization: lowercase; camelCase split; every run of non-alphanumerics collapsed to one underscore
firewall.rule: ez-b003-discovery-feature-firewall-v1: in the discovery profile a feature name is rejected when it is not in the declared allowed set, or when its normalized form contains a denied token or matches a denied pattern. The denylist is defense in depth; the primary protection is the explicit feature-policy manifest, whose hash enters the split digest, the freeze, and every certificate.

separation_policy.derivation_rule: ez-b003-derived-observable-v1: S2n, S2p, delta2n, and delta2p are algebraic combinations of the binding energies used to compute them, and those binding energies are algebraic combinations of mass excesses. A derived observable is not independent evidence from its inputs: it re-expresses them. Atlas facts for these quantities carry derived = true, independent_evidence = false, and the exact input identities.
separation_policy.shell_indicator_caveat: A large positive local change in delta2n or delta2p is consistent with shell structure; it is not proof of a magic number. No local maximum is promoted to a closure claim, and no p-value is reported without a preregistered null model.
separation_policy.training_rule: No model is trained on a derived target. Models predict mass excess; binding energy and every separation observable are computed afterwards.
